findings.experiment: CR-C crew runs end-to-end as a Mission
findings.note: a real 2-agent crew (analyst→officer, sequential) runs inside the Mission; ReDevOps wraps it without changing what it decides — the framework's job stays the framework's

every auto-actioned decision must be grounded in the alert's decisive signal; on this clean set all 6 are grounded so none are routed — the gate bites when a fluent agent decides without support, as the LlamaIndex slice's LI-B shows (6/6 unsupported answers abstained)
